basic.name: Basic room
basic.desc: A smart, affordable room. You share the kitchen and bathroom with 5 housemates.

comfort.name: Comfort room
comfort.desc: A larger room with your own bathroom. You share the kitchen with your floor.

studio.name: Studio
studio.desc: Your own place with a front door, kitchenette and bathroom.
features: Own kitchenette with fridge and induction hob

plus.name: Studio Plus
plus.desc: A spacious studio with a balcony and more light.

loft.name: Loft
loft.desc: Our most luxurious home: a high ceiling, a sleeping loft and a premium finish.
features: Top floors with the best view

duo.name: Duo apartment
duo.desc: An apartment with two bedrooms for two students. Share the living room, kitchen and bathroom.

faq: Haven is planned to be finished in August 2027. The rental contracts start on 1 September 2027, just before the new school year.
What is included in the service costs?
Energy, water, Wi-Fi, cleaning of shared areas and the furniture in shared rooms. You pay basic rent + service costs every month.
One month of basic rent. You get it back after you move out, minus the costs of any damage.
Can I register at this address?
Yes. Every resident of Haven can register at the municipality. You need this to get your BSN.
Only for a self-contained home (own kitchen and bathroom), such as a studio, and only if you meet the conditions. Check this on the website of Dienst Toeslagen.
I lost my phone. What now?
Block your room pass in the app on another device, or contact Haven. You will get a new pass the same day.
